extension.description: Unofficial: run Cursor agents in VS Code with your Cursor plan and API key. Not affiliated with Anysphere.
command.revertLastSession: Cursor: Revert Last AI Change Session
config.enableAiNativeFeatures.descriptio: Master switch for the additional AI-native editor features. Core chat remains available when disabled.
config.enableAutopilot.description: Enable autonomous outcome-based change sessions through the Autopilot command.
config.enableChangeSessions.description: Track AI edits, show the AI Change Session view, and enable checkpoint-based review and revert.
config.previewGeneratedCode.description: Show a diff and require Apply or Discard before applying Generate Code results.
config.enableDiagnosticQuickFixes.descri: Add Cursor AI Quick Fix actions to diagnostics in the editor.
config.enableAiReview.description: Enable AI review commands and line-level findings in the Problems panel.
config.enableVerification.description: Enable manual and automatic compile, lint, test, or custom verification commands.
config.enableDebugContext.description: Enable AI analysis of the active debug session, diagnostics, and breakpoints.
config.enableProjectMemory.description: Enable project-memory guidance and the project-memory refresh command.
config.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a notification when an agent run finishes. Skipped while the chat view is visible and VS Code is focused.
config.playSoundWhileRunning.description: Play a calm chime periodically while the agent is running.
config.playSoundOnComplete.description: Play a distinct chime when the agent finishes successfully.
config.playSoundOnError.description: Play a distinct alert when the agent stops because of an error.
config.autoVerify.description: Run detected or configured verification commands after an AI agent edits files.
config.autoRepair.description: Ask the agent to repair failed verification automatically. This can use additional plan quota.
config.maxAutoRepairAttempts.description: Maximum automatic repair attempts for one user request.
config.verificationCommands.description: Commands to run after AI edits. Leave empty to detect validate, compile, lint, or test npm scripts.
config.enableInlineCompletions.descripti: Enable experimental AI inline completions. Disabled by default because each request uses Cursor plan quota.
config.includeProjectMemory.description: Tell agents to read .cursor/rules.md and .cursor/project-memory.md when present.
